blocks.text: Thank you for turning the allocations around so quickly. They reached us on Friday, James Green has already folded them into the baseline, and the reconciliation now ties out to within a rounding difference on the {{fact:f:E-2009-001.client}} numbers, which is exactly where we want it before we benchmark.

The one remaining gap is the vendor spend file, which Deborah Gordon needs to finish the comparator work; if your team can send it across this week, we will hold the schedule without difficulty. I have flagged it as the single open item on the shared list so that nothing else is waiting behind it.

For the call itself, the aim is narrow: to walk the reconciliation line by line so that your team and ours are agreed on the baseline before we take the benchmarking any further. Nothing on our side is a conclusion yet, so please have your people come ready to press on the numbers; a question raised in the room is worth far more to us than a silent doubt.

On the working call we set for later this week, I have us down as James Green, Deborah Gordon, and Michael Walker from our side, with Sandra Frazier and the allocations owner from yours. I will send a short agenda the day before so that we keep it to the half hour.
